name: ServiceNow UAT Ground Truth Benchmark Suite
description: Versioned golden benchmark suite for evaluating defect detection quality, false-pass rates, and false-alarm rates.

scenarios.title: Clean Control: Standard Incident Lifecycle
scenarios.description: Verify standard incident creation and lifecycle transition to In Progress and Resolved with valid mandatory closure fields.
steps: Create new incident with short_description='Email server latency', category='Software', caller_id='system_admin'
Verify state is 1 (New) and priority is calculated
Set state to 2 (In Progress) and assigned_to='system_admin'
Save and verify sys_updated_on advanced
Set state to 6 (Resolved) with close_code='Solved (Permanently)' and close_notes='Restarted MTA daemon'
Save and verify incident state is 6 (Resolved)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Incident progresses cleanly through states to Resolved without defect.

scenarios.title: Seeded Defect: Priority Matrix Calculation Failure
scenarios.description: Set impact=1 (High) and urgency=1 (High); verify system calculates priority=1 (Critical). In seeded defect, priority remains 3 (Moderate).
steps: Open incident in state 1 (New)
Set impact to '1' and urgency to '1'
Submit form
Verify priority field equals '1' (Critical)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Priority calculated as 1 (Critical). Seeded defect leaves priority unchanged or at 3.
scenarios.risk_reasoning: Critical priority matrix calculation error affects SLA timers and paging.

scenarios.title: Seeded Defect: Missing Mandatory Close Code on Resolution
scenarios.description: Attempt to resolve incident without close_code and close_notes. System should enforce data policy. In seeded defect, resolution succeeds without closure notes.
steps: Open active incident in state 2 (In Progress)
Set state to 6 (Resolved) leaving close_code and close_notes blank
Click Save
Verify client/data policy blocks transition and displays mandatory field validation error
scenarios.expected_outcome: Form submission blocked with mandatory field error on close_code and close_notes.
scenarios.risk_reasoning: Missing mandatory closure notes breaches ITIL data governance.

scenarios.title: Seeded Defect: Category-Based Assignment Group Rule Bypass
scenarios.description: Create incident with category='Network' and subcategory='VPN'. Assignment rule should auto-assign to 'Network Support'. In seeded defect, group remains empty.
steps: Create incident with short_description='VPN gateway unreachable', category='Network', subcategory='VPN'
Save incident
Verify assignment_group is populated with 'Network Support'
scenarios.risk_reasoning: Unrouted incidents linger without SLA ownership.

scenarios.title: Seeded Defect: Missing Event Notification on Escalation
scenarios.description: Escalate priority to Critical. Business rule should queue sysevent 'incident.escalated'. In seeded defect, event is never fired.
steps: Update incident priority to 1 (Critical)
Save incident
Verify sysevent entry created for name='incident.escalated' and instance=incident sys_id
scenarios.risk_reasoning: Missing on-call notifications for P1 outages breaches enterprise SLA.
